description: This file defines the ClientClusteringValidator class, which implements configuration validation for client-side clustering in Orleans. It checks whether a gateway list provider is configured and throws an exception if not.

classes.name: ClientClusteringValidator
classes.description: Validator class for ensuring client clustering is properly configured in Orleans.

methods.description: Constructor that initializes the validator with a service provider.
